caption: The drawing depicts a teacup placed on a matching saucer. Both the teacup and saucer are primarily a light cream color with gold accents around their rims and a gold handle on the cup. The outer surface of the cup and the inner surface of the saucer are decorated with a pattern of green leaves and clusters of dark red or purple blackberries. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, and there is a small red signature on the right below the saucer. The composition is centered on the page, with the cup positioned slightly angled to show both the side and interior of the cup as well as the saucer beneath it.
title: Moustache Cup and Saucer
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
